questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from another lane will be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange and red diamond sign is attached to vehicles that travel slower than normal traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a T-intersection. It warns that a road will join from the right side ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles don't have turn signals. Instead, bicyclists use hand and arm signals. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means yield. Slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and traffic may merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed carefully. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle means yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers what traffic laws apply. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to hazards right ahead. The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.
